pages.title: Most Common Foundation
pages.text: The light gray chalk uses mineral compounds to enhance the foundation of a pentacle.$(br) The foundation is an important property, often considered the stabilization of the "core."$(br)

Due to its relatively low cost and inherent magical properties, it is the most common$(br) foundation option among practitioners of occultism, capable of replacing white chalk$(br) in almost all pentacles.$(br)
